liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Slowest and softest performance, noted as beautiful and well pronounced; Slow, mellow tempo is particularly loved by the reviewer [12][16][20]
- **Playing In The Band Jam** (2 reviews): Second half features an interesting fusion jam; Multiple segues in and out of the song are highlighted [12][16]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-03-02.139734.fob.nak700.streeter.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 25 songs; 146 min [1]
- **gd1981-03-02.175076.sbd.miller.phase-repair.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 154 min [4]
- **gd1981-03-02.nak700.wagner.miller.90450.sbeok.flac24**: source not stated; 22 songs; 156 min; rated 4.18/5 by 11 [5]. Said about its sound: Fabulous audience recording allowing listeners to feel the energy of the crowd [20]
- **gd1981-03-02.nak700.wagner.miller.90165.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 156 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [6]. Said about its sound: Clean and crisp, conveying the small, home-like size of the venue [12]

## Around the show

- Hell's Angels were present, with one asking to use the water fountain [17]
- Slower tempo than other shows, described as tasty rather than sloppy [11]
- Second set rated five stars, first set three stars; better than 1981 shows [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-03-02.139734.fob.nak700.streeter.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Frank Streeter; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: Frank Streeter's Master FOB Audience Cassette; Nakamichi CM-700 > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell MX90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) >… [1]. Also: Patches from the motb nak700 source supply missing audio segments [1]
- **gd1981-03-02.175076.sbd.miller.phase-repair.flac1644**: transferred by DAT Supplied By Rob Eaton Transferred By Digitalrbb Mastered By Charlie Miller  November 10, 2025; source: SBD > Cassette Master > Reel > DAT (48k) [4]. Also: Vocal phase issue repaired, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [4]
- **gd1981-03-02.nak700.wagner.miller.90450.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 (With Bass EQ) -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell DXLIIS/Dolby B) D [5]. Also: 24-bit source from Bob Wagner's masters; a 16-bit version also circulates [5]
- **gd1981-03-02.nak700.wagner.miller.90165.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 (With Bass EQ) -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell DXLIIS/Dolby B) D [6]
